summary: 16 tools for Unity UI animation and editor workflows: shape curves, stagger keys, build UGUI layouts, import PSD layers and organize reusable assets.
description:
UI Animation & Workflow Toolkit brings 16 focused tools to Unity's Animation Clip and UGUI workflows. Shape repeated transitions, stagger UI elements, bake motion and organize the assets you use every day. Includes 16 English PDF guides.

ANIMATION EDITING
• Curve Flow: apply an easing shape between selected keys while retaining endpoint values.
• Frame Offset: align and stagger selected keys or property curves relative to the playhead.
• Key Value Offset: shift selected values to match a scene value at the first or last selected key.
• Posterize Time: resample curves into stepped motion; this does not change game frame rate.
• Animation Randomizer: generate seeded jitter or Perlin variation.
• Expression Linker: transform a source curve with arithmetic and bake target curves; not a live expression engine.
• Bezier Curve Motion: author a 2D path and bake position with optional Z rotation.
• Animation Path Fixer: inspect and repair binding paths after hierarchy changes.
• Apply Last Frame: apply each supported numeric curve's final stored value to scene components.
• Keep Last Frame Only: modify the current clip in place, retaining each curve's last key at time zero. Duplicate the clip first to preserve the original.

UI AUTHORING
• Quick UI Builder: create UGUI nodes, batch rename, set pivots and add component shortcuts.
• MatKeyframer: key selected shader properties through a component on a UGUI Graphic. This is one shader-property animation tool, not a shader editor or material library.

ASSET REUSE
• Asset Favorites: bookmark and organize project assets without moving their source files.
• Prefab Browser: browse folders, search prefab paths and drag assets into your workflow.
• Particle Browser: organize, tag and preview particle prefabs. Particle effects are not included.

PSD TO UGUI
• PSD Importer: export supported visible layers and rebuild a UGUI hierarchy. Requires local Python with psd-tools and Pillow. This is not a pixel-perfect Photoshop renderer; unsupported effects need preparation or manual correction.

BEFORE YOU BUY
Several animation tools read native Animation-window selection through reflection into internal Unity Editor APIs. This is version-sensitive and remains an Asset Store review consideration. MatKeyframer targets UGUI Graphic components, not mesh renderers. PSD text marked #txt uses Legacy Text, not TextMeshPro. Editing, reimport and managed-library removal can change or delete content; Undo coverage varies. Read the relevant guide and back up source assets.

Documentation: https://hermityin.github.io/motilayer-tools/
technical:
PACKAGE
• 16 tools and 16 English PDF guides; separate Editor and Runtime assemblies.
• Upload version: Unity 6000.0.26f1. An upload version is not a verified compatibility range.
• Windows is the intended desktop platform; no blanket cross-platform or cross-version guarantee.
• Menu root: Tools > UI Animation Toolkit.

ANIMATION
• Selection tools require editable Animation Clips and the active Animation window; selection requirements vary.
• Some integrations use reflection into internal Editor state. Unity upgrades may break them.
• Curve Flow needs at least two selected keys per processed property.
• Keep Last Frame Only edits the existing clip; it does not automatically create a backup.

MATKEYFRAMER
• UGUI Graphic component; 4 Float, 4 Color, 2 texture offset/scale and 2 Vector4 slots.
• Uses material instances and runs in player builds when attached. Review batching, masks and material switching.
• Not a material library, shader authoring system or MeshRenderer animation tool.

PSD IMPORT
• External Python installation with psd-tools and Pillow; follow the installation guide.
• Supported visible layers and layout data; generated texture dimensions are padded to multiples of four.
• #txt layers create Legacy Text, not TMP; unsupported effects and fonts require manual correction.
• Reimport can overwrite generated images and prefabs.

STORAGE AND SAFETY
• Asset Favorites uses local EditorPrefs.
• Particle Browser manages copied library content; removing an entry can delete its managed Import folder without Undo.
• Most utilities edit project data independently of rendering. Particle previews and shader animation depend on compatible shaders and assets; universal pipeline support is not claimed.
• No required Asset Store package dependencies; external Python dependencies still apply.
• Undo support is tool-specific.

Documentation: https://hermityin.github.io/motilayer-tools/

summaryZh: 面向 Unity UI 动效制作的 16 项工具：编辑缓动曲线、批量错帧、烘焙路径动画、搭建 UGUI、导入 PSD 图层，以及整理和复用资源。附 16 份英文 PDF 使用说明。
descriptionZh:
这套工具面向使用 Unity Animation Clip 与 UGUI 的 UI 动效师、技术美术和开发者，集中处理曲线调整、错帧、路径烘焙、UI 搭建与资源整理等重复操作。

动画编辑（10 项）
• Curve Flow：在选中关键帧之间应用缓动形状，保留起止数值。
• Frame Offset：相对播放头对齐并错开选中关键帧或整条属性曲线。
• Key Value Offset：以首个或最后一个选中关键帧为锚点，整体偏移数值以匹配场景属性。
• Posterize Time：重新采样曲线，生成阶梯式运动，不改变游戏运行帧率。
• Animation Randomizer：使用种子生成 Jitter 或 Perlin 变化。
• Expression Linker：用算术表达式变换源曲线并烘焙到目标，不是运行时实时表达式系统。
• Bezier Curve Motion：编辑二维路径并烘焙位置和可选的 Z 轴旋转。
• Animation Path Fixer：检查并修复层级变化后的动画绑定路径。
• Apply Last Frame：把各条受支持数值曲线的最后一个存储值应用到场景组件。
• Keep Last Frame Only：直接修改当前 Clip，只保留各曲线末键并移到零秒；保留原动画需先复制 Clip。

UI 搭建与属性动画（2 项）
• Quick UI Builder：创建 UGUI 节点、批量重命名、设置轴心及添加组件快捷入口。
• MatKeyframer：通过 UGUI Graphic 上的组件给指定 Shader 属性制作关键帧。它是单一属性动画工具，不是材质库或 Shader 编辑器。

资源复用（3 项）
• Asset Favorites：收藏、分类和查找项目资源，不移动源文件。
• Prefab Browser：按文件夹与路径文本查找、浏览和拖放 Prefab。
• Particle Browser：分类、标记和预览粒子 Prefab；不附带粒子特效素材。

PSD 转 UGUI（1 项）
• PSD Importer：导出受支持的可见图层并重建 UGUI 层级。需要本地 Python、psd-tools 和 Pillow；不是像素级还原 Photoshop 的渲染器。

购买前请注意
部分动画工具通过反射访问 Unity Editor 内部 API 来读取原生窗口选择，存在版本兼容和商店审核风险。MatKeyframer 面向 UGUI Graphic，不支持网格渲染器。PSD 中 #txt 文本使用 Legacy Text，而非 TMP。不受支持的效果、字体需要手动处理。曲线修改、重复导入及素材库移除可能覆盖或删除内容，Undo 支持因工具而异，请先备份。

附 16 份英文 PDF；在线索引：https://hermityin.github.io/motilayer-tools/
technicalZh:
• 上传所用版本：Unity 6000.0.26f1；不等于经过验证的兼容版本范围。
• 面向 Windows 桌面工作流，不作全平台、全版本兼容保证。
• 16 项工具、16 份英文 PDF；Runtime 与 Editor 程序集分离。
• 菜单根路径：Tools > UI Animation Toolkit。
• 选择类动画工具依赖当前 Animation 窗口和可编辑 Clip；部分实现通过反射读取内部状态，Unity 更新可能影响功能。
• Curve Flow 每条属性至少需要两个选中关键帧；Keep Last Frame Only 原地修改 Clip，不自动备份。
• MatKeyframer：UGUI Graphic；4 个 Float、4 个 Color、2 组纹理偏移/缩放、2 个 Vector4 槽位。使用材质实例，挂载时会在 Player 中运行；需检查批处理、遮罩与材质切换。
• PSD：需要外部 Python、psd-tools 和 Pillow；纹理尺寸补齐为四的倍数；#txt 使用 Legacy Text，不是 TMP。重导入可能覆盖生成的图片和 Prefab。
• Asset Favorites 收藏存于本地 EditorPrefs；Particle Browser 删除条目可能不可撤销地删除托管 Import 文件夹。
• 大部分工具处理项目数据；粒子预览与材质动画仍取决于 Shader 和素材，不承诺全渲染管线兼容。
• 无必须购买的 Asset Store 包依赖，但有上述 Python 依赖；Undo 支持以各工具说明为准。
